summary: In dev environment, the source ingestion controller defaults to reconcile_only mode, which historically registered connectors but never executed them (hardcoded 0 pulls, provider egress not attempted). When DEV-PAPER-MARKET-INPUT-STALENESS-001 added the dev-paper-us-equity-simulation connector, it was reconciled into state but never executed by the controller, leaving source_ingest.data_source_instances at 0 and market snapshots unrefreshed (observed in GitHub Actions dev deploy run 35332947461, where the dev paper baseline timed out and triggered rollback). Fixed by inspecting connector definitions dynamically: any connector that is provably egress-free (empty allowed_host_patterns, auth_modes subset of {'none'}, empty secret_fields) is scheduled and executed even in reconcile_only mode using exclusive_connector_ids scoping. Connectors that declare network hosts remain strictly unexecuted without explicit opt-in bounded profiles. Controller tick results continue truthfully reporting provider_egress_attempted=false since no network egress occurred.

root_cause_investigation.method: Analysis of GitHub Actions dev deploy run 35332947461 logs, controller_worker.py execution logic, and source ingestion readback validation.
findings: In controller_worker.py lines 1488-1498 (prior to fix), when config.mode == RECONCILE_ONLY_MODE, run_schedule_tick was never called. Instead, a dummy schedule summary {'total_reconciled_connectors': ..., 'total_provider_pulls': 0} was emitted with provider_egress_attempted=False.
The reconcile_and_pull mode required explicit exclusive_connector_ids and failed closed if not provided, meaning automated scheduled execution in dev relied solely on reconcile_only.

As a result, dev-paper-us-equity-simulation was registered by persona_source_reconciler into connector desired/actual state, but no scheduled tick ever executed its adapter. Latest market snapshots were never generated, causing dev paper baseline deployment step in run 35332947461 to fail with market_input_stale / PERSONA_PROVISIONING_READBACK_FAILED and rollback to the 2026-09-13 image.

The architectural purpose of reconcile_only is to prevent outbound network egress and credential leakage in dev/test topologies. A connector whose definition declares allowed_host_patterns=(), auth_modes=('none',), and secret_fields=() cannot perform network egress. Therefore, executing provably egress-free connectors under reconcile_only preserves all network isolation guarantees while allowing dev simulation to generate required market data.

description: services/source_ingestion/connector_definitions.py: Added is_egress_free_connector_definition(definition) function and ConnectorDefinition.is_egress_free property. A connector is classified as egress-free if and only if allowed_host_patterns is empty, auth_modes is a subset of {'none'} (or empty), and secret_fields is empty.

services/source_ingestion/controller_worker.py: In run_controller_tick when config.mode == RECONCILE_ONLY_MODE, all reconciled connectors are dynamically checked for is_egress_free. If any egress-free connectors exist, run_schedule_tick is executed exclusively and forcibly for those egress-free connector IDs. The resulting schedule payload maintains mode='reconcile_only' and provider_egress_attempted=False.

services/source_ingestion/controller_worker.py: In _validate_due_state_readback, added executed_connector_ids parameter. When egress-free connectors are executed under reconcile_only, validates that all executed connectors are indeed egress-free, allows source_record_count progression (must not decrease), ensures non-executed connectors' latest records and health are untouched, and strictly enforces that dlq_count and frontier_backlog do not leak or change.

services/source_ingestion/tests/test_dev_paper_simulation.py: Added assertions to test_connector_definition_registered_and_enabled_for_us_price_daily verifying is_egress_free is True, allowed_host_patterns is empty, and auth_modes is ('none',).
